name: EPIC 212285353
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 10.3 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212285353 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.347027 (16th-84th percentiles 10.078462-11.045299), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212285353 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3487.265625 (16th-84th percentiles 3433.28125-3584.84375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,487 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.00 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,957 K at its surface.
